messages.text:
The binary on this machine is Windows-flavored, so long view uses Windows attribute-style permissions (`-a---`, `d----`) and directories show `-` for size.

I’m going to keep the port tuned to this runtime and add enough option compatibility to ignore common display flags while still matching the evaluated behavior area.

"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$ref=(Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); $tmp=Join-Path (Get-Location) '"'probe3'; if(Test-Path "'$tmp){Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $tmp}; New-Item -ItemType Directory $tmp | Out-Null; foreach($s in 0,9,999,1000,9999,10000,999999){fsutil file createnew (Join-Path $tmp "f$s") $s | Out-Null}; & $ref --color=never --icons=never -l --sort=size $tmp'
